description: Evaluates the nuclear-jet level, the third of the three levels prf:confined-knot-binding names. It is defined by jet-filtered-knot-factor (word: the Jones polynomial of the nuclear quotient braid on the A(A-1)/2 inter-nucleon crossings) and jet-convergence-classical-limit (weights w~_lambda = d_q(lambda)^2/[n]_q!). At A = 2 the quotient braid closes to the unknot, J = 1, for every bond type and both resolutions of the averaged pn letter, so the level contributes exactly 1. At A >= 3 the pair multiset does not determine the word: 4 distinct Jones polynomials over 12 orderings at A = 3, 30 over 1440 at A = 4, so a(Z,N) = J is not a function of (Z,N). And the weights are a different family from the Markov trace the quark and nucleon levels use: convention D excludes (1,1,1) with y = 0 while w~ charges it at 0.1634, sum dim*y = 1 but sum w~ = 0.98744, and on the single pn letter y gives 0.508229789376739 against w~'s 0.000071511999729, a factor of 7105. The three-level product is therefore not evaluable as specified. No binding claim; both jet blocks are Conjectures and neither is retracted.
caveats: Both source blocks are labelled Conjecture. Neither is retracted here; the probe reports what they specify and what a well-posed reformulation would have to supply.
The k -> infinity convergence claim of jet-convergence-classical-limit is NOT tested. Only the k = 3 exactness claim's weights are.
No binding claim. B = alpha L remains the open interpretation of rem:bond-log-ratio-is-a-free-energy.
